definition: Karayol-Borroto-Haghshenas neurodevelopmental syndrome (KBHS), an autosomal dominant neurodevelopmental condition caused by heterozygous variants in the MSL2 gene, clinically characterized by developmental delay, brain structural abnormalities (such as ventriculomegaly), motor incoordination, epilepsy, and distinct dysmorphic features.

source.title: Prenatal Diagnosis of MSL2‐Related Ventriculomegaly in Association With an Inherited 15q13 Microduplication
source.quote: The Male-Specific Lethal 2 Homolog (MSL2) gene was recently reported to be responsible for a novel, rather severe neurodevelopmental syndrome including brain abnormalities.
